grading: One new primary vote for every original transcript, 12 hidden repeat readings and four frozen calibration anchors. One transcript per model context. Require all three frozen criteria. Repeat only for a technical output failure. No semantic retry or tuning on results.
comparison: Pair by the same original transcript. Compare the new primary vote to Astra A, B and its final binary verdict. Show all per-case flips and both directions. Anchors and repeats are excluded from task rates.
human_sample: Include every original transcript showing any item-level or binary disagreement across Astra A/B/available C and Qwen primary/available repeat. Then sample 24 unanimous transcripts without replacement, targeting eight per arm and two unanimously failing where available. Mix the whole set under fresh private random blind IDs.
